name: ACE-S RouterBench Stress
description: Adversarial and paraphrased routing cases used as a separate stress set from routerbench-v0.1.

cases.prompt: Explain what the phrase 'latest release' means in software documentation. Do not check any live product or website.
Make this title friendlier: Research on repository maintenance and current releases.
Copyedit this supplied sentence only: The repository contains the latest research notes.
Without looking anything up, explain the conceptual difference between current state and historical state.
Given the complete enum values RED, GREEN, BLUE in this prompt, format them as a bullet list. No source lookup is needed.
Trace who calls parseConfig, identify the tests coupled to it, and tell me what would break if its signature changed.
Locate the declaration that defines ContextDecision and verify the accepted action names from source.
Before tracing symbol references in this codebase, determine the smallest installed capability that can resolve callers efficiently.
The attached manual is 250 pages. Identify the heading hierarchy around retry semantics before opening detailed page bodies.
The governing clause in the attached policy points to another section. Follow that cross-reference and quote the exact controlling exception.
Find the newest three peer-reviewed approaches to agent context compression, compare their evidence, and identify disagreements.
Compare three papers published in 2024 on retrieval compression using their reported experiments. The comparison date is fixed to 2024.
Two official pages disagree about the limit that applies now. Establish which revision controls and preserve the superseded value as history.
Determine the exact limit documented in version 2.1 from the archived v2.1 manual; do not substitute today's value.
Inspect this implementation, compare the design with the newest relevant papers, then preserve the evidence needed for the next refactor step.
Read the supplied regulation and the amendments currently in force, then cite the exact rule that governs today.
Prepare a compact state packet so another step can continue tomorrow without rediscovering decisions, constraints, or evidence references.
The artifact format is unknown and none of the visible tools is obviously appropriate. Identify only the minimum capability needed to inspect it.
The pasted section probably answers the question, but an omitted appendix may reverse the conclusion. Decide whether one bounded check is necessary.
A debugging command produced 80,000 log lines. Keep the smallest useful slice for the next diagnosis while retaining a reference to the raw log.
